prompts.name: tier2-heavy-broadsword-four-view
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a game weapon modeling reference sheet matching the supplied tier-2 medieval longsword reference in rendering style, craftsmanship level, neutral gray background, soft studio illumination, realistic subtly worn silver forged steel and dark brown leather wrap. SAME tier 2, affordable well-made equipment, not a legendary upgrade. Four aligned full-length orthographic views of ONE consistent design, front, back, left edge, right edge arranged left to right. Pommel at top, blade point downward, identical scale and heights in all views, entire objects with margins, plain gray background. Side views genuinely edge-on, correctly showing thickness and guard depth. No people, no action, no scabbard, no gems, no gold, no glow, no ornate engravings. Small clear English view labels beneath each view. Subject: a tier-2 broad-bladed heavy sword branching from the reference longsword. Blade approximately 1.65 times as broad relative to the grip as the reference, robust straight double-edged blade with restrained central fuller, strong angular shoulders and orderly taper toward tip, practical solid steel crossguard with broad beveled ends, longer hand-and-a-half dark leather grip, substantial faceted steel pommel retaining the reference family resemblance. Convey weight and sturdiness through blade width and guard structure, not spikes or giant fantasy slab proportions. Steel has small forging marks and minor scuffs. Clearly different from the slim standard longsword while remaining in same simple medieval collection.

prompts.name: tier2-elegant-rapier-four-view
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a game weapon modeling reference sheet matching the supplied tier-2 medieval longsword reference in rendering style, craftsmanship level, neutral gray background, soft studio illumination, realistic subtly worn silver forged steel and dark brown leather wrap. SAME tier 2, affordable well-made equipment, not a legendary upgrade. Four aligned full-length orthographic views of ONE consistent design, front, back, left edge, right edge arranged left to right. Pommel at top, blade point downward, identical scale and heights in all views, entire objects with margins, plain gray background. Side views genuinely edge-on, correctly showing thickness and guard depth. No people, no action, no scabbard, no gems, no gold, no glow, no ornate engravings. Small clear English view labels beneath each view. Subject: tier-2 lightweight elegant rapier intended for a graceful female game character. Communicate elegance through balanced slender proportions and flowing minimal construction, not jewelry. Long straight narrow tapering steel blade, clearly slimmer than reference, subtle diamond cross section, slim dark leather grip comfortably sized for one hand, modest elongated faceted steel pommel. Distinctive SIMPLE swept hilt: two restrained curved steel quillons and one slender smooth knuckle bow curving back toward the pommel with clear generous negative space. No dense basket, no complex filigree. Softly flowing guard curves contrast with clean straight blade. Understated refined poised silhouette, silver steel and dark leather only, fine restrained wear, practical readable geometry suitable for 3D reconstruction. All four views MUST agree on the asymmetrical knuckle bow's true position and depth; left and right profiles reveal its loop shape correctly.
